summary: Iter47 end-to-end test of Kasir (POS), Penjualan Online, Laporan (Harian/Bulanan/Tahunan/Online/Laba Rugi), and Stok Opname per request. Backend: 26/26 tests passing against production preview (test_iter47_full_flow.py). POS creates transaction with Tunai/Transfer/QRIS, reduces stock, generates invoice; delete restores stock. Penjualan Online creates sale per channel with marketplace fees, reduces stock; admin delete restores stock; status update works; kasir forbidden (403). Reports (daily/monthly/yearly/ecommerce/cash/dashboard) all return 200. Stok Opname adjusts product stock, records history; kasir can create opname but cannot delete (admin-only). Role-based: kasir can create tx & opname, blocked from product CRUD (403). Frontend: Admin + Kasir login OK; POS flow executed end-to-end in browser (invoice INV-20261011-0003 generated, stock reduced, receipt+WA buttons shown); Penjualan Online shows 5 channels + 6 products, add-to-cart + submit works; Reports pages (Harian, Bulanan, Tahunan, Online, Laba Rugi, Stok Opname) load without crash; Kasir can access POS + Stok Opname with PDF/Excel buttons visible.

issues: Rapid page reloads during automated testing occasionally trigger 429 on /src/index.js causing an Emergent 'Part of app failed to load' popup. Not a production/code issue — Vite dev-server rate limiting through the ingress.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2391 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting by domain (auth, products, transactions, ecommerce, reports, payroll, loans, attendance, opname).

Several endpoints call ObjectId(sid) directly without ObjectId.is_valid() guards (e.g., /ecommerce/sales/{sid}, /ecommerce/sales/{sid}/status, /ecommerce/sales/{sid}/cair, /ecommerce/sales/{sid}/ongkir, /transactions/{tid}/reminded). Passing a malformed id returns 500 instead of 404. /stok-opname/{oid} already does this correctly — replicate that pattern.

/api/transactions (create) does not enforce stock availability before deducting; _apply_sale_items decrements stock even if resulting stok goes negative (verify in _apply_sale_items). Consider validating stock >= qty for non-bundle items.

Monthly/yearly report endpoints accept year/month as separate int query params; frontend must send them separately (confirmed in LaporanBulanan/Tahunan). No action needed, but documenting signature mismatch risk for API consumers.
DELETE /api/transactions restores stock implicitly — behavior should be documented in response or audit log.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows verified; export-button re-verification flaked due to Vite dev-server 429 after rapid localStorage reset — buttons exist in code and were visible to Kasir)

Note: products use field 'harga_jual' (not 'harga'); reports/monthly expects separate year & month int query params; ecommerce/reports needs mode=bulanan|harian with year/month or date.
